scope: Five existing personnel profiles: Mon Mothma, Bib Fortuna, retained Ayla/Aayla Secura, Eeth Koth and Poggle the Lesser. No new identities, episode evidence, credits, editions or dates.

records.scope: First scoped personal review: all seven inherited fields assessed, original short description, selected named roles, individual facts and work/place/species relationships. Not a complete biography, appearance inventory or end-credit review.
limitations: The Databank’s Revenge of the Sith appearance list includes material the official Who Is Mon Mothma article explicitly identifies as deleted scenes. No ordinary released-film connection is added for that entry; the qualification is recorded as a separate fact.

The current published nominal height is 1.5 m (150 cm). Blue eyes and red/ginger hair are explicit in the official Rebels/Secret Cargo commentary, so those fields are qualified to that portrayal rather than inferred from images or generalized across every actor and era.

Chandrila is explicitly her homeworld in the separate political-background article, not a newly established exact birthplace. Coruscant residence, Yavin operation and the Dantooine orbital broadcast have distinct relationships. Ship carriage/personal-shuttle association does not establish piloting.
Her existing Rebels physical/transmission episode rows remain unchanged. The 2025 overview’s then-future Andor wording is not a current status claim; all era-specific roles are not simultaneous.

Each inherited field is assessed separately. Nominal published dimensions are not actor measurements or every costume/configuration, and photographs do not establish unsourced colour, mass, gender or birth-year fields. Unknown or none is not converted into zero or proof of biological absence.

Named work-level links are selected evidence, not every episode, edition, voice-only role or deleted scene. The Clone Wars here means the television series, not an automatic appearance in the 2008 feature. Omitted links remain unestablished rather than proving absence.
No new identities, episode-register entries/reviews, dates, editions or credits are added. Original-USA launch scope and all earlier episode/profile evidence remain intact.
